# G2 checklist (for the user, by hand)
Questions only a real HP Prime G2 (firmware 2.4 rev 15515) or the official Virtual Calculator can answer. The G2 is never connected to the laptop. Until a question is answered, anything that depends on it is `source: assumed`. Write the answer and the date next to each item (firmware version once, the first time); the answer then becomes `source: device` (or `virtual-calc`). The last column lists the golden cases that depend on each item (tests/golden/).

| # | Area | Question | Why we ask | Asked by | Answer | Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
